subject: Current priority: existing boards, image reconciliation and bounded video preparation
body:
Ziggy's current priority, relayed through Nova Dot: Claude's preferred Fable allowance is exhausted for the next couple of days; preserve writing quality with no downgrade, model change, credits purchase or reactivation. Use existing authored boards for image housekeeping, flagged-repair reconciliation and video preparation; major new writing/canon is paused. This coordination starts no new generation order, paid run or batch expansion. Preserve originals, exact review IDs, scoped choices and ratings versus validation versus creative acceptance.

Keep Grok ownership and existing authorized jobs; this notice starts no job. Prioritize EXISTING returns: C04-002 v002/v003 are cataloged but unaccepted, original still Needs fixes; James v002_clean/v003_noholster/v004_clean plus stencil revisions exist beyond older v001 intake and need exact-version/hash/lineage accounting before any repeat repair. Reconcile GrillUp 02/03 order and two-hoop continuity against selected r4/external-off references, preserving the plan. For neck-chain/prop work, distinguish acknowledged packet, actual visual inspection, existing-job outputs and pending outputs; do not duplicate 24/50 orders. Preserve V1's frozen observation run; no automatic grading, key comparison or rerun. Hold the unreviewed character packet and new canon. Acknowledge priorities and report existing returns/remaining gaps at your next authorized active checkpoint; posted is not delivery or start.
